about: The per-release smoke of docs/model-tiers.json (scripts/tier-smoke.py): one greedy prompt per Tier 1 file, its stdout byte-compared to a pin under tier-smoke/, one pin per device class and backend. The prompt asks for a fact from outside the system (expect must appear in the continuation); the pin only says whether this build reproduces the one that wrote it. -b is fixed because the prompt batch is otherwise sized from free RAM on a GPU build. A row may override prompt, n_predict, expect or args.
